title: Accessibility Testing Test Cases — Playwright + axe-core Companion
title_es: Casos de Prueba de Accesibilidad — Companion Playwright + axe-core
description: Runnable focus-trap fixture (accessible modal with keyboard trap handling) plus a Playwright 1.48 spec asserting the WCAG keyboard and axe-core checks from the resource — loads via file://, no server needed.
description_es: Fixture ejecutable de trampa de foco (modal accesible con manejo de teclado) más una spec de Playwright 1.48 que asserta los checks WCAG de teclado y axe-core del recurso — carga vía file://, sin servidor.
run: npm install && npx playwright test a11y.spec.ts
